# Al-Imam Malick Islamic Institute

> Best Private English, Arabic, Islamic & Quran School in Kanifing, The Gambia - From Nursery to High School (Senior Secondary School) under Sumpundoukati Society.

## About

Al-Imam Malick Islamic Institute, under Sumpundoukati Society, is one of the leading private schools in The Gambia, located in Kanifing South, Serekunda, Kanifing Municipality. We are recognized as the Best Private School in Kanifing and among the Best English Schools in The Gambia.

We provide complete academic pathway from Nursery to High School, integrating modern English curriculum with Arabic, Islamic Studies, and Quran memorization (Hifz & Tajweed). We serve students across Kanifing Municipality, Serekunda, and Greater Banjul Area.

Founded under Sumpundoukati Society, our mission is to produce academically excellent and morally upright students equipped for Deen and Dunya.

## Educational Levels

- Nursery School / Early Childhood Education
- Lower Basic / Primary School
- Upper Basic / Junior Secondary School
- Senior Secondary School / High School / Senior High School
- Quran Memorization (Hifz) Program
- Arabic Language Institute
- Islamic Studies Institute

## Key Programs

- English Curriculum: Nursery to Senior Secondary, WASSCE preparation
- Arabic Language: Comprehensive Arabic language from beginner to advanced
- Islamic Studies: Authentic Islamic education and character development
- Quran School: Hifz (memorization) and Tajweed, recognized as best Quran school in Kanifing
